body:
Rod Overview & Strategic Role

The Masterline Rod is the definitive Tier S endgame fishing rod in Roblox Fisch. Boasting a staggering 1000% lure speed, 350% luck bonus, and an uncapped infinite weight limit, it represents the ultimate fishing achievement. It cannot be bought from merchants with C$; it is unlocked exclusively by completing 100% of the Bestiary and 100% of the Rod Journal.

Parametric Specifications

Parameter Value
Tier ClassificationTier S
Acquisition PriceEndgame Milestone (Free)
Max Weight CapacityInfinite / Uncapped
Luck Bonus350%
Lure Speed1000%
Control Rating0.2
Line Resilience50%
Vendor / Unlock SpotReward for completing 100% Bestiary and 100% Rod Journal

All Rods Required for Masterline (Rod Journal Checklist)

To unlock the Masterline Rod, your in-game Rod Journal must achieve 100% completion. You must acquire and register every standard, milestone, and specialized rod across all progression brackets:

  • Starter & Early-Game Rods: Flimsy Rod, Training Rod (300 C$), Plastic Rod (900 C$), Carbon Rod (2,000 C$), Fast Rod (4,500 C$), Lucky Rod (5,250 C$), and Steady Rod (7,000 C$).
  • Mid-Game Progression Rods: Fungal Rod (Mushgrove Swamp), Fortune Rod, Magma Rod (Roslit Volcano), and Avalanche Rod (35,000 C$).
  • Late-Game & High-Luck Rods: Kings Rod (100,000 C$, Keepers of Kings), Destiny Rod (190,000 C$, requires 350 discovered fish in Bestiary), and Great Dreamer Rod (275,000 C$).
  • Specialized & Quest Rods: Great Rod of Oscar, Blade of Glorp, and Astraeus Serenade.

Gameplay Tactics & Meta Recommendations

  • Weight Ceiling: Lands all colossal mythicals and hunt species up to the infinite cap without line snapping.
  • Acquisition Path: Clear all zone species entries in your Bestiary first, then complete the remaining vendor and quest rods on the checklist above.
  • Mutation Stacking: Stack with Mutation Surge events and the Mutated enchantment to maximize Shiny and Sparkling yields.
